thread:
priya: Heads-up — after rolling the 'route-header rename' in the platform last night, the console quota dashboard shows a bunch of requests attributed to `unknown` for some customers. Not all SDKs are sending the new header consistently.
andre: ack. seeing the same in dev logs, looks like python and go libs still emit `X-Redwood-Route` while TS emits `X-RW-Route`. backend accepts both but our attribution layer only reads `X-RW-Route` now.
sam: oof, that's on me — the TS client patch added the shorter header a week ago. PTAL: we didn't coordinate the platform renaming window.
liz: console: we rely on route header for per-route quota buckets and dashboard tiles. When header missing, we fall back to service-level bucket -> appears as `unknown` in the UI.
priya: immediate question: is it safe to revert platform side to accept both headers for a migration window?
andre: yes, we can add a 30d dual-read. quick fix deployed to edge in ~30m. will also add a metric for mismatched headers.
ci-bot: test-failure: sdk-go/e2e: header-normalization-tests failing (2/12). See: https://ci.redwood/12345
sam: I'll cut a TS patch to also emit `X-Redwood-Route` (backcompat) and keep `X-RW-Route`. small change.
liz: for the console UX: could we add a temporary note on the quota dashboard explaining attribution needs header migration? reduces noise for CS.
console-bot: created ticket RW-1247: "Quota dashboard: show migration banner & attribution debug" assigned to product/console.
andre: long-term we should standardize on a single header and an SDK opt-in feature flag so customers can toggle the new header early. proposal: `client.routing.use_new_route_header` boolean in SDKs. default false for 6 weeks, then true.
priya: agree. also need telemetry: emit `route_header_version` in our sampled telemetry so we can measure adoption per SDK and region.
sam: draft TS change (will open PR):
```ts
// set both headers if feature flag off->on transition
headers['X-RW-Route'] = route;
headers['X-Redwood-Route'] = route;
```
andre: go patch is similar: add env var `RW_ROUTE_HEADER_V2=true` for canary.
liz: console: add a per-customer adoption column to the quota dashboard so CS can target outreach.
priya: timeline: 1) deploy platform dual-read (30m) 2) SDK patches (TS / py / go) within 24h 3) add telemetry sampling for header version in next telemetry batch 4) console banner + adoption column within 72h.
sam: starting TS PR now, will mark as hotfix.
andre: deploying dual-read to staging now. notify when live so we can monitor metrics.
priya: thanks — once dual-read live I'll coordinate an opt-in announcement and add docs snippet for the three SDKs. @sam @andre please ping when PRs open. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: ts-sdk PR #482 opened by sam: https://git.redwood/sdk-ts/pull/482
ci-bot: go-sdk PR #210 opened by andre: https://git.redwood/sdk-go/pull/210
sam: PR includes a small test to ensure both headers are present for now.
liz: after metrics look good we'll schedule the header deprecation notice and a firm date. keep this thread for coordination.
priya: 👍 will update RW-1247 with rollout timeline and docs snippets.
andre: metric spike looks normal; mismatched-header gauge trending down after canary patch to a few customers.
priya: closing loop: CS alerted, banner added to dashboard beta, docs draft in product repo. thanks all.
